paite: Bang i genta dia le? Hehpihna akhansem theihna ding in khelhna ah i om nilouh ding ua hia?
heading: Khelhna Sihsan Theihna
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

paite: Om nilouh lou hial ding! Eite khelhna lam a sisa, khelhna ah bangchi in i hing thei lailai dia?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

paite: Eite Khrist Jesu a baptis lut a om tengteng asihna ah baptis lut in i om chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

paite: Huaiziak in asihna a baptis lut a om in amah toh vuikhawm in i om uhi, huchi a Pa thupina in misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh tak bang a eite leng hinna thak a i khosak theihna ding in.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism to death, that just like Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

paite: Asihna kibatpih a amah toh i kizop khit ngalleh athohnawnna kibatpih in leng i kizom ngei ding uhi.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

paite: I mihing lui akiang ah kilhden in a-om samta chih i thei; huchi a khelhna pumpi hihmanthat a a-omtheihna ding leh tua kipan a khelhna sikha a i omlouhna ding in.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

paite: Kuapeuh sisa khelhna lak ah asuaktata hi.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

paite: Huan Khrist toh i sih samleh akiang ah i hing sam ding chih i gingta uhi.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

paite: Misi lak a kipan Khrist kaihthoh in a-omta, asi nawn kei ding chih i thei ngal ua; sihna in amah tung ah thu aneita kei hi.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

paite: Asihna khelhna lam thu ah tangtawn a ding in khatvei kia asi a, ahinna bel Pathian lam thu ah ahing ahi.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou leng khelhna lam thu ah sisa in kisep unla, Pathian lam thu ah bel Khrist Jesu ah hing in kisep un.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Huaiziak in na pumpi uh duhgawlna thumang ding in na pumpi sithei uah khelhna vai hawmsak kei un.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

paite: Na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatlouhna vanzat ding in khelhna kiang ah pe phal sam kei un; himahleh misi lak a kipan hing nawn bang in Pathian kiang ah kipia unla, na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatna vanzat ding in Pathian kiang ah pe phal zaw un.
english: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

paite: Noute dan thunuai a om hilou a, hehpihna nuai a om na hih ziak un khelhna in na tung uah thu anei nawn kei ding hi.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

paite: Bangchi in ahita dia le? Dan thunuai a om i hi kei ua, hehpihna nuai a om i hih zawk ziak in i khial ding uh ahi diam? Hilou hial ding!
heading: Khelhna Sikhate Pathian Sikha Suahna
english: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

paite: Kua kiang peuh ah leng athu mang ding a asikha dia na kipiak un sihna khop a khelhna sikha hiam, diktatna khop a thumang sikha hiam, athu na man uh sikha na hi uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that to whom you present yourselves as servants to obedience, his servants you are whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

paite: Himahleh Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen; noute khelhna sikha na hita mah le uchin, thuginpi a na kipiakna uh na lungtang taktak un na zuita uhi.
english: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto you were delivered.

paite: Khelhna lak a kipan suahtaksak in na omta ua, diktatna sikhate na hong hita uhi.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

paite: Na sa uh hat louh ziak in mihing dan in thu ka gen hi; na sahiangte uh nitna leh tatlekna ding a tatlekna kiang a sikha ding a na piak phal bang un, tu in na sahiangte uh sianthouna ding in diktatna kiang ah sikha ding in pe zaw un.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

paite: Khelhna sikhate na hih lai un diktatna lak ah na siang uhi.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

paite: Huai na thil zahpihsate uah, huai lai in gah bang ahia na muh zel uh? Huai thilte tawpna zaw sihna ahi.
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

paite: Tu'n ah bel khelhna lak a hihsiang a om in, Pathian sikhate na hong hih un, sianthouna mu khop in na gah uh na nei uh akei hiam, huai tawpna tangtawn a hinna toh.
english: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

paite: Khelhna man sihna ahi ngal a, Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Khrist Jesu ziak in tangtawn a hinna ahi.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
